failed: REQUIRED-revoke-refuses-previously-admitted: post-revoke isError=false bytesReturned=true — the durable overlay can only REMOVE restrictions (overlay-decision.mjs header + admission-port.mjs:497-521: "it can remove authority, never grant it"), so revoking the only writable effect (a deny) re-admits the call; there is no revocable ALLOW layer in the decision path and no recompile on a generation bump. Missing seam: a decision-path ALLOW that a revoke can withdraw. Two lawful shapes: (A) let the centre's overlayDecision return allow as well as deny, so a durable ALLOW stands in for a lane deny and its revoke restores the deny; (B) derive the compiled member lane + centre binding from the overlay snapshot and re-bind on generation change (extend the A5-M1 publication), so a revoked ALLOW recompiles to deny and the fact carries the new generation.
